summary.text: Clint Owlett is a Republican state representative from the Northern Tier of Pennsylvania who has represented House District 68 since June 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is the House Republican Caucus Secretary and a former business owner who grew up on a dairy farm.

paragraphs.text: Owlett was born and raised in Tioga County and grew up on a dairy farm in Middlebury Center, according to his official biography.
He graduated from New Covenant Academy High School in 2001, completed an internship with Three Springs Ministries, and worked there as director of program development and then general manager.
He also worked in the family store, Owlett's Sunshine Farm Market, and started his own construction and decorative concrete business in 2012.
Owlett took office in June 2018, and his biography lists his top priorities as strengthening families, supporting agriculture and representing rural Pennsylvania.
He has sponsored bills that became law, including one establishing the Dairy Investment Program, and for the 2025-26 session his peers elected him Republican Caucus Secretary.
He serves on the boards of the Center for Dairy Excellence and the Pennsylvania College of Technology.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Quentin Gee as his opponent in the general election.
